ranked.headline: Single-cell and DNA models face simple baselines, attribution audits and retrieval tests
ranked.summary: Benchmarks test single-cell and DNA models against simple baselines and replicates, while agentic and SQL interfaces aim for grounded, checkable outputs.

ranked.headline: Perturbation response models add cross-context transfer and regulatory-path constraints
ranked.summary: Several new preprints pair generalizable perturbation-response predictors with explicit regulatory, pathway or dynamical structure in single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Interpretable omics models predict therapy response, toxicity and survival
ranked.summary: New models predict irAE risk, pediatric brain tumor survival and immunotherapy response from scRNA-seq, methylation and immune-state inference.

ranked.headline: Disentangling cell abundance, state, and regulation in single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple abundance, state, trajectory, and regulatory inference rather than estimating each layer in isolation.

ranked.headline: Harnesses, memory and audit protocols, not model tier, set biology agent reliability
ranked.summary: New agent systems for drug screening, binder design, gene reports and autonomous wet labs pair LLMs with provenance, bounded loops and benchmark audits.

ranked.headline: Histology and host transcriptomes used to infer unmeasured spatial molecular layers
ranked.summary: New preprints predict spatial protein, transcriptome and pathogen maps from histology or host RNA, alongside missing-modality survival models.

ranked.headline: Frozen single-cell foundation models reused for cross-modal and imputation tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained single-cell foundation models are now adapted as fixed backbones for multiome, transcriptome, and chromatin analysis beyond their original scope.

ranked.headline: Harmonized spatial and single-cell resources standardize access to tissue-scale data
ranked.summary: Public spatial and single-cell resources now number in the thousands of datasets, making harmonization and provenance tracking central to their reuse.

ranked.headline: Sequence data resolves microbial identity, strain type and drug susceptibility
ranked.summary: Rapid growth of public metagenomic sequencing data and WGS-based prediction tools makes sequence-driven typing and phenotype inference a current priority.

ranked.headline: Coupled kinetics and mechanics infer hidden rules from chromatin structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple mechanics, kinetics and reaction-diffusion to polymer or condensate models, tying dynamical parameters to observed structure.

ranked.headline: Controlled benchmarks probe ML models for ADMET, peptide solubility, and antibody traits
ranked.summary: Recent matched-protocol benchmarks show gains are endpoint-dependent rather than uniform across model families for molecular property prediction.

ranked.headline: Graph pangenomes resolve structural and gene-content variation across strains
ranked.summary: Graph-based pangenome analyses now resolve structural variants and gene-content variation across fungal, gut bacterial, and metagenomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Methods operate on raw reads and pileups while profiling memory and throughput limits
ranked.summary: New tools pair read-level inputs with measured compute behavior, from memory-bound mapping profiles to 10M-cell CPU workflows.

ranked.headline: Curated microbial catalogs and long-read profiling tools expand genomic resources
ranked.summary: Global catalogues of food and anaerobic digestion microbiomes now pair curated metadata with long-read-compatible profiling methods.

ranked.headline: Transferring learned relationships across cohorts, cancers and cell lines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply transfer across cohorts, cell lines and cancer types to TCGA-scale omics prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Sequence models predict single-molecule chromatin accessibility and co-accessibility
ranked.summary: Single-molecule footprinting resolves per-molecule chromatin states, and sequence models now predict them as distributions.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-aware and confounder-aware inference methods for microbiome data
ranked.summary: New shrinkage, benchmarking and integration methods target compositionality and confounding as microbiome cohorts and variant-level analyses scale.

ranked.headline: Reducing mapping ambiguity and bias in transcript-level RNA-seq quantification
ranked.summary: New isoform quantification methods target mapping ambiguity and bias, benchmarking against spike-ins and established tools such as Kallisto and Salmon.

ranked.headline: Curated databases link RNA, toxin, and plant virus data to 3D structures
ranked.summary: Recent resources pair curated binding, probing, and sequence measurements with 3D structural models across toxins, RNA, and plant viruses.

ranked.headline: WGD subclones and clonal fraction reveal doubling dynamics beyond binary tumour status
ranked.summary: Pan-cancer and single-cell studies now date WGD against drivers and detect doubled subclones in tumours classed as non-WGD.

ranked.headline: Tools link biological networks to omics containers, GO annotation and visualization
ranked.summary: Three preprints dated November 2026 extend software handling of annotated biological networks across omics containers, GO annotation, and client-side visualization.

ranked.headline: Software for hybrid capture probe and oligo pool library design with in silico checks
ranked.summary: Recent releases deliver hybrid capture probe and oligo library design as installable software, with BaitBench adding in silico outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models resolve tissue- and cell-context-specific disease signatures
ranked.summary: Spatial, single-nucleus, and imaging readouts are now coupled to interpretable models and genetic or mechanistic validation.

ranked.headline: Automated and differentiable pipelines advance cryo-EM and crystallographic hit analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a peer-reviewed tomography picker address automation, reconstruction, and density validation in cryo-EM workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep and unsupervised models prioritize noncoding variants by regulatory impact
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs DNA language models, 3D genome structure, and MPRA supervision with sequence models to refine noncoding variant prioritization.

ranked.headline: Assembly-level genomes and annotation tools span mosses, annelids and algal relatives
ranked.summary: Recent assemblies and standardized annotation pipelines make cross-lineage comparisons of genome structure and content tractable.

ranked.headline: Inferring glioblastoma invasion and proliferation parameters from imaging-derived models
ranked.summary: Single-timepoint MRI and single-cell ex vivo imaging now yield mechanistic glioblastoma parameters through explicit modeling.

ranked.headline: Frameworks and resources standardize scoring of diverse human variant classes
ranked.summary: Benchmarks, membrane protein and CNV resources, and pipeline validation frameworks now extend variant interpretation beyond missense scoring.

ranked.headline: Computational tools test and accelerate RNA structure prediction and validation
ranked.summary: AlphaFold 3 accuracy drops on novel RNA folds, prompting validation of deep-learning RNA predictions against deposited structures.

ranked.headline: Model-guided design of proteins and molecular sequences tested against measured outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative and predictive models with experimental or benchmark tests of designed proteins, enzymes and activation domains.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models extend to RNA structure, glycosylation, and epitopes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pretrained DNA, RNA, and protein language models with structure, domain, and contact information.

ranked.headline: Curated antibody and TCR databases add ML-ready structures and specificity profiles
ranked.summary: SAbDab2 and the TCR Motif Atlas update curated structure and specificity resources, while AlphaFold 3 is applied to predict TCR antigen specificity.

ranked.headline: Web platforms unify transcriptomic, proteomic, imaging and genome annotation resources
ranked.summary: Public imaging archives now exceed 11 PB, and genome browser releases add live configuration and streaming access for integrated analysis.

ranked.headline: Proteome-scale mapping of protein expression, structure, and function in bacteria
ranked.summary: Pooled yield assays, dual-sgRNA CRISPRi screens, and whole-proteome predictors now generate protein-level data at proteome scale for reuse.

ranked.headline: Testing transcriptomic inferences against confounders and independent readouts
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints test transcriptomic inferences against independent evidence rather than accepting in-sample fit.

ranked.headline: Scoring predicted complexes, epitopes and RNA-protein contacts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend confidence scoring and epitope retrieval beyond protein-protein contacts to nucleic acid and ligand interactions.

ranked.headline: Diverse-cohort genomics refines heritability, regulatory mapping and imputation
ranked.summary: Large diverse cohorts and reference panels are now resolving rare, non-coding and population-specific variant effects across global populations.

ranked.headline: Reference-matched assemblies enable cistrome and methylation-variant analysis in crops
ranked.summary: Short-read composite and linear pan-references now support TF footprinting and epigenetic-genetic profiling across diverse crop accessions.

ranked.headline: Explicit references for judging biological model outputs in genome folding and cryo-EM
ranked.summary: Three October to November 2026 preprints test model outputs against explicit biological or measurement references rather than accepting them as opaque.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose shared de novo peptide errors and test fragment-ion priors in MS/MS
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and preprints test how fragment-ion evidence and learned priors constrain MS/MS molecular identification.
